Layout

Shell

The page grid: a full-bleed main column plus an optional aside that becomes a sticky column above 1024px. This page is a live instance.

<div class="ui-shell"><main class="ui-shell-main" id="example-main"><p>Main column</p></main><nav class="ui-shell-aside"><p>Aside</p></nav></div>

One column below 1024px; main plus a --ui-shell-aside-width track above it. --ui-shell-max defaults to none, so the shell is edge to edge -- cap prose with ui-measure rather than narrowing the shell.

Container

A container's max-width only matters at full page width, wider than this demo column -- default/fluid/widescreen/fullhd render identically here but differ in a real page.

Default container -- max-width 1200px.
is-fluid container -- no max-width, always full width.
is-widescreen container -- max-width 1344px.
is-fullhd container -- no max-width above the fullhd breakpoint.

Nav list

Vertical navigation for sidebars and drawers -- not to be confused with the menu dropdown above.

  • Container
  • Hero
  • Tile

The active item takes aria-current; the token is a parameter because this list cannot know whether its links change pages or only move the viewport. These are in-page anchors, so they pass location -- page would announce "current page" for a link that never leaves it. Unrelated to menu(), which is an absolutely positioned dropdown.

Nav group

Labelled groups of nav links, as used by this page's own table of contents.

Layout

  • Container
  • Hero

Forms

  • Field
  • Input

Labels are <p>, not headings, so grouping a nav does not inject entries into the document outline. Any class_ or attributes land on one outer ui-nav-groups wrapper -- per-group would emit the same id more than once. This page's table of contents is a live instance.

Drawer

An off-canvas panel on the Popover API: light dismiss, Escape and focus return come from the browser, with no JavaScript.

Example drawer

Click the backdrop, or press Escape.

Built on the Popover API, so light dismiss, Escape, top-layer stacking and focus return to the button are the browser's job -- no JavaScript. Opens from the start edge so it does not land on top of the table of contents.

Burger

The button that opens a drawer, and the only thing needed to toggle one.

Targets the same panel as the drawer section above. The accessible name is a visually hidden <span> rather than aria-label, so the control keeps a name if the stylesheet fails to load. The bars cross via :has(.ui-drawer:popover-open): a popover invoker's expanded state is implicit ARIA and never a DOM attribute, so CSS cannot select on it. One consequence is visible here -- :has() cannot bind a burger to one specific drawer, so opening either panel crosses every burger on the page.

Tabs

Keyboard-accessible tablist; state stays server-owned, switching is progressive enhancement.
